primary_context.title: Li, Fabrication of CMOS Integrated Circuits, Chapter 3
primary_context.use: Antenna charging and qualitative threshold/leakage tradeoff only; no unprovided numerical process characterization.

source_decisions: Printed footer establishes Spring 2008; the mixed-year compilation is never treated as one exam.
Q2 printed output gates are OR and AND with no output bubbles. O0 is steady constant 1; preserve the original physical network and distinguish physical path arc sums from sensitizable edges.

Q2 balanced numerical mean delays require Rp = Rn. General Rp/Rn formulas are included because Q2 does not state a mobility ratio. Dual-Vt selection is conditional on quantified slack and is not a unique global optimum.
Q3 uses the printed eta = (PT-PL)/PT, an intermediate-load overhead fraction. Integer N and recomputed beta preserve the actual load.
Q4 brackets the first two of three inverters. Alpha = 1 and 2 both meet T = 6RC; alpha = 1 minimizes the modeled switching power.
Q5 is a forward full adder. The printed final row is 111 -> s = 1, co = 1; the photo circle is annotation. The graded booklet instead solves an inverse relation and is corrected.
Q5 prints (10%), while the preceding questions total 90 points. Preserve the percentage mark and interpret it as the remaining ten points only for the coverage total.
publication: Only the authentic two-page original, reconstructed exam, independent solutions and verification evidence are published; references remain local.
